summary: v52o — Vendor invite screen: country field replaced by a 250-country master dropdown; invite email send is now awaited and reported (email_sent in API response + audit event), with a UI warning toast when dispatch fails instead of a fake success.

verification.country_dropdown: vendor-invite-country select renders 250 options from /api/v1/masters/countries; selecting United Arab Emirates stores AE (screenshot iteration_83_invite_country2.png).
verification.email_delivery_visible: POST /vendors/invite returned email_sent=true; backend log shows Resend HTTP 200 OK for the message.
verification.failure_path: email_sent=false now produces a warning toast with retry guidance (code-reviewed path).
